trigger: Two actual A10040 stockouts in us-central1-a before any GPU/model start; Google named us-central1-c/f/b as alternatives.

proposed_placement.snapshot_scope: regional storage only; no cross-region/multi-region data transfer
proposed_placement.source_deployment: Git only; exact committed context60 source, no secret-bearing archive
proposed_placement.auth: Existing Mac Google OS Login/IAP/strict authenticated host keys; no credential transfer

cost.storage_and_rate_preflight: Read actual disk type, snapshot retention/settings and current official regional SKUs before creating anything. Abort if cost bounds/retention cannot fit. No change to project-wide retention settings.

preservation: No owner conversations, owner credentials, private keys/tokens, quarantined cores or unapproved archive transfers. Existing source disk contains the previously authorized native/synthetic/runtime material; credentials have remained on Mac.

Freeze original disk/VM stopped before snapshot. Verify snapshot READY, restored disk ancestry/size, exact critical checkpoint/config/corpus hashes and actual unchanged cached-example hashes when loaded.
Create at most one stopped replacement envelope/disk at a time; use existing restricted IAP tag and no service account/scopes. Check quota/price and real provider stock before any model run.

After actual stockout before any GPU/model start, retire only the newly created empty VM/disk before trying next named zone. Never have overlapping GPU jobs. Stop after one actual model workload begins.
Use native provider STOP plus independent Mac and guest guards before model. Fail closed on access or budget errors.

Stop GPU and copy back actual checkpoints/optimizer/RNG/OPAL/recipes/results/receipts with scoped rsync/full hashes. Preserve originals and all failed attempts. Remove only newly created replacement resources after preservation verifies; snapshot cleanup within4hours and account for up to72hours provider recycle storage.
No GPU for snapshot/transfer waiting. New disk aggregate live time ≤4hours across sequential attempts. Cleanup if all stock out.
reason_for_decision: Current explicit execution is fixed to the SAME zonal disk and prohibits new storage/replacement placement. The unchanged budget does not itself authorize a replacement disk/snapshot. These changes are required to use Google-reported capacity in another zone.
